note: Hand-curated. Every date below is read from the primary source quoted beside it. A row with no date_iso has no date we could verify, and says so. Re-check every row after any statutory instrument, writ or change of governance.

calendar.coverage_label: Council list and dates; no 2027 forecasts yet
calendar.summary: The ordinary day of local elections in England is the first Thursday in May. Not every council votes every year: which councils elect in 2027 depends on each council's own cycle, set by its electoral change order or council resolution.

sources.label: Representation of the People Act 1983, s.37(1)
sources.quote: In every year the ordinary day of election of councillors is the same for all local government areas in England ... and is (a) the first Thursday in May

sources.label: MHCLG, letter from Jim McMahon MP to council leaders in reorganisation areas, 7 September 2026
sources.quote: elections scheduled to take place in May 2027 will go ahead to existing council boundaries

calendar.summary: First mayors of Cumbria and of Cheshire and Warrington, and the Bedford, Middlesbrough and Mansfield mayoralties. The Leicester City Mayor is due the same day but has no forecast yet. Each contest's own source is on the mayoral page.

sources.label: Cumbria Combined Authority Order 2026 (draft order laid before Parliament), art.6(2)
sources.quote: The first election for the return of the mayor is to take place on 6th May 2027.

sources.label: Cheshire and Warrington Combined Authority Order 2026 (draft order laid before Parliament), art.6(2)
sources.quote: The first election for the return of the mayor is to take place on 6th May 2027.

sources.label: Leicester City Council, local government reorganisation (accessed 24 October 2026)
sources.quote: Local elections will take place as planned in May 2027 using the existing council boundaries.

calendar.summary: Every Scottish council elects its whole membership every five years. Each council has a placeholder page giving this date; we publish no Scottish council results or forecasts.

sources.label: Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994, s.5(1C)
sources.quote: After the ordinary election of councillors in 2017 the next ordinary election shall take place in 2022, and ordinary elections shall take place every fifth year after that.

sources.label: Representation of the People Act 1983, s.43(1)
sources.quote: in every year in which ordinary elections of councillors for local government areas in Scotland are held, the day on which the poll is held at an election is (a) the first Thursday in May

calendar.summary: Welsh principal councils elect their whole membership every five years. Each council has a page giving this date; Newport and Powys also carry results from single contests on 7 May 2026. We publish no 2027 Welsh council forecasts.

sources.label: Local Government Act 1972, s.26(1), as amended
sources.quote: The ordinary elections of councillors of the new principal councils shall take place in 2022 and in every fifth year after 2022.

sources.label: Representation of the People Act 1983, s.37ZA(1)
sources.quote: In every year the ordinary day of election of councillors is the same for all local government areas in Wales ... and unless subsection (2) applies or an order under subsection (1A) provides otherwise, is (a) the first Thursday in May

calendar.summary: The statutory date for the next Assembly election. The Act allows an earlier poll in some circumstances. We publish nothing for Northern Ireland.

sources.label: Northern Ireland Act 1998, s.31(1)
sources.quote: the date of the poll for the election of each Assembly shall be the first Thursday in May in the fifth calendar year following that in which its predecessor was elected

calendar.body: Mayor of London and London Assembly
calendar.summary: London's last ordinary election was in May 2024. We list the contest on the mayoral page and will forecast it closer to polling day.

sources.label: Greater London Authority Act 1999, s.3(2)
sources.quote: The poll at each subsequent ordinary election shall be held on the first Thursday in May in the fourth calendar year following that in which the previous ordinary election was held.

calendar.summary: Most combined and strategic authority mayors are next due in May 2028. We have not seen each authority's order confirm the exact day, so we give the month only. The roster is on the mayoral page.

The Prime Minister can ask for an earlier election at any time. If none is called, Parliament dissolves automatically at the start of 9 July 2029, five years after it first met, and polling day follows 25 working days later.

sources.label: Dissolution and Calling of Parliament Act 2022, s.4
sources.quote: If it has not been dissolved earlier, a Parliament dissolves at the beginning of the day that is the fifth anniversary of the day on which it first met.

sources.label: Hansard, House of Commons, Tuesday 9 July 2024, vol. 752
sources.quote: The House met on the first day of this Parliament, pursuant to Proclamation.

sources.label: Darlington Borough Council, UK Parliamentary (General) Elections (accessed 24 October 2026)
sources.quote: The next Parliamentary (General) Election will take place no later than Wednesday 15 August 2029 unless a 'snap' Election is called.

calendar.summary: The previous ordinary election was on 7 May 2026. The next falls on the first Thursday in May in the fourth calendar year after it, unless it would clash with a UK general election poll or is moved by proclamation.

sources.label: Government of Wales Act 2006, s.3(1)
sources.quote: The poll at an ordinary general election is to be held on the first Thursday in May in the fourth calendar year following that in which the previous ordinary general election was held

calendar.summary: The previous ordinary election was on 7 May 2026. The next falls on the first Thursday in May in the fifth calendar year after it, unless it would clash with a UK general election poll or is moved by proclamation.

sources.label: Scotland Act 1998, s.2(2)
sources.quote: The day on which the poll at an ordinary general election for membership of the Parliament is to be held is the first Thursday in May in the fifth calendar year following that in which the previous ordinary general election was held

not_covered.note: We publish nothing on PCC elections and give no date for them here.
